# oneprovider_image (Resource)

OneProvider image resource (like AWS AMI).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vm_id` (String) Source VM ID to create image from

### Optional

- `name` (String) Image display name

### Read-Only

- `date` (String) Creation date
- `id` (String) Image ID
- `os_display` (String) OS display name
- `os_name` (String) OS name
- `size` (Number) Image size in GB
